MyAir

“My air” for the Taza Air app: how much polluted air a person breathes in over a day, a walk or a ride — and what actually helps to breathe less of it. Pick an example person and a month of 2025: every screen recalculates from AAI data.

Interactive prototype of the “My air” tab in Taza Air. Start from the main screen and tap, scroll and go deeper like in the app. To go back, use “‹ Back”, the ← key or swipe from the left edge.

Example person

Each one has a different day. The app recalculates everything for the person you pick.
